But in browser, `` is abrupt-closing empty comment, so img becomes live element and fires alert(1). This is the bypass. Plan: Write this payload to /app/out.html and run the test to confirm it triggers the alert after filtering." Need pytest. Plan: run test with pytest. Tool call: cd /app && python -m pytest test_outputs.py -v 2>&1 | tail -25; observation: No module named pytest. - event-0008 step 9: thought: pytest isn't installed. Manually invoke test function by importing and calling. Plan: small Python snippet imports test and calls function. Tool call: cd /app && python -c "import test_outputs as t; t.test_out_html_bypasses_filter()" 2>&1 | tail -25; observation: AssertionError: Filter failed with error: python: can't open file '/tests/filter.py': [Errno 2] No such file or directory. - event-0009 step 10: thought: test uses /tests/filter.py which doesn't exist. Earlier cp to /tests failed silently (directory missing). Need create /tests/filter.py as copy. Plan: create /tests directory, copy filter.py, rerun test. Text: '1'. - event-0010 step 11: thought: test passed. Payload survives filter... task complete. Tool call: mark_task_complete. Future summary: confirmed test passed, marked complete. Need discover reusable semantic edge types supported by trajectory. Focus on relationships involving core events, overlap events too. We need infer edge types. Event-0009 creates directory and copies filter.py to fix failure, then reruns test. This is repair. Also event-0007 failure: pytest missing, event-0008 attempts to manually invoke test function? That's not repair exactly, it's workaround to avoid missing pytest. Could be "WORKAROUND_FOR_MISSING_DEPENDENCY" or "ATTEMPTS_TO_REPAIR"? Hmm. - USES_PREVIOUS_RESULT_AS_INPUT: The agent uses the observed output from filter (payload unchanged) as evidence to decide payload works; then writes it to /app/out.html. But event-0005 output was used in event-0006: agent uses the result (payload unchanged) to confirm bypass and then write to out.html. This is an earlier observation used as input for subsequent action? More specifically, the agent interprets observation (filter output unchanged) as successful bypass and uses it to create final artifact. candidate_edge_types.source_description: An earlier execution observation confirming that a candidate technique or payload achieves the desired effect.
candidate_edge_types.target_description: A subsequent agent action that applies the confirmed technique to construct or deploy the final solution artifact.

candidate_edge_types.name: VERIFIES_SOLUTION_BY_EXECUTING_TEST
candidate_edge_types.definition: A subsequent agent action executes a test or validation procedure to determine whether a constructed or modified solution satisfies the task requirements.
candidate_edge_types.source_description: A constructed or modified solution artifact produced by the agent.
candidate_edge_types.target_description: An execution of a test or validation procedure intended to check the solution.

candidate_edge_types.name: DIAGNOSES_FAILURE_CAUSE
candidate_edge_types.definition: An observed execution failure or unexpected absence of output leads the agent to analyze and identify the root cause of the failure.
candidate_edge_types.source_description: An observed execution failure or unexpected result.
candidate_edge_types.target_description: A subsequent agent diagnostic analysis identifying the underlying cause.

candidate_edge_types.name: ADAPTS_TO_UNAVAILABLE_TOOL
candidate_edge_types.definition: A failure caused by a required tool or command being unavailable leads the agent to select an alternative method for performing the intended operation.
candidate_edge_types.source_description: An observed failure caused by unavailability of a required tool or command.
candidate_edge_types.target_description: A subsequent agent action that uses an alternative method to accomplish the intended operation.

candidate_edge_types.name: ATTEMPTS_TO_REPAIR
candidate_edge_types.definition: A subsequent agent action attempts to resolve a failure identified during an earlier execution step.
candidate_edge_types.target_description: A subsequent agent action intended to resolve that failure.

candidate_edge_types.name: RETRIES_OPERATION_AFTER_REPAIRING_CAUSE
candidate_edge_types.definition: After taking action to repair the cause of an earlier failure, the agent repeats the previously failed operation.
candidate_edge_types.target_description: A repeated execution of that operation after the cause of the failure has been addressed.

candidate_edge_types.name: USES_DIAGNOSIS_TO_SELECT_REPAIR_ACTION
candidate_edge_types.definition: A diagnostic conclusion about the cause of a failure determines the specific corrective action taken next.
candidate_edge_types.source_description: A diagnostic analysis identifying the root cause of a failure.
candidate_edge_types.target_description: A subsequent repair action selected to address that root cause.

candidate_edge_types.name: COMPLETES_TASK_AFTER_SUCCESSFUL_VERIFICATION
candidate_edge_types.definition: A successful verification result leads the agent to decide that the task is complete and to signal task completion.
candidate_edge_types.source_description: A verification result indicating that the solution satisfies the requirements.
candidate_edge_types.target_description: A subsequent task-completion decision or action.
